impact_scope.description: Introduces the public option API for setting and reading SPNG_KEEP_UNKNOWN_CHUNKS.

evidence: S0 contains no matching spng_set_option/spng_get_option declaration or implementation; this public option API did not yet exist.
The older spng_get_unknown_chunks API is a sibling surface and is not part of this comparison scope.
S1 publicly declares and implements spng_set_option() and spng_get_option() for SPNG_KEEP_UNKNOWN_CHUNKS.
H0 never calls either new function and therefore does not exercise option selection, value normalization, retrieval, or their invalid-argument paths.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 must add calls to the newly introduced option API, including a caller-supplied option value and an output location for retrieval, to expose this surface.
evidence: Calling spng_set_option(ctx, SPNG_KEEP_UNKNOWN_CHUNKS, value) is a new caller action unavailable in S0.
Calling spng_get_option(ctx, SPNG_KEEP_UNKNOWN_CHUNKS, &value) requires a new call and caller-provided output storage.

reason: The anchored public option API is absent in S0, so its own pre-change gap is false. It exists in S1 but unchanged H0 does not invoke it, making the post-change gap true. The identical-scope transition is therefore NEW and requires harness maintenance.
